# Role In Narrative

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RoleInNarrative`](gmeow-RoleInNarrative.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RoleInNarrative>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, interpretive fact that a character bears a narratological role RELATIVE TO A SCOPE — protagonist of the trilogy, of one book, of one chapter are different claims. Vantage-indexed through the statement layer; ensemble works carry coexisting protagonist relators and NO primaryProtagonist exists or ever will ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Flat shortcut [`gmeow:hasNarrativeRole`](../properties/gmeow-hasNarrativeRole.md) for the 80% single-work case.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RoleInNarrative`](gmeow-RoleInNarrative.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
